title_zh: 医院门诊 & 承包商安全管理（一）
title_en: Day1: Hospital Outpatient & Contractor Safety Management (I)

vocab.example_en: Please take the patient to the emergency room right away.
vocab.example_zh: 请立刻把病人送到急诊室。

vocab.example_en: Please wait in the outpatient lobby until your number is called.
vocab.example_zh: 请在门诊大厅等候叫号。

vocab.example_en: Please go to the inpatient lobby to complete admission procedures.
vocab.example_zh: 请前往住院登记大厅办理入院手续。

vocab.example_en: Please register at the internal medicine department on the second floor.
vocab.example_zh: 请到二楼内科挂号。

vocab.example_en: Please show your medical insurance card before registration.
vocab.example_zh: 挂号前请出示医保卡。

vocab.example_en: Your GP may refer you to a specialist for further examination.
vocab.example_zh: 全科医生可能会将你转诊给专科医生进一步检查。

vocab.example_en: Your primary care doctor will coordinate your overall treatment.
vocab.example_zh: 家庭全科医生会统筹你的整体治疗。

vocab.example_en: Take a fever-reducer if your temperature exceeds 38.5 degrees.
vocab.example_zh: 体温超过 38.5 度时请服用退烧药。

vocab.example_en: Shake the cough syrup well before use.
vocab.example_zh: 服用前请摇匀止咳糖浆。

vocab.example_en: Please come back for a follow-up check in one week.
vocab.example_zh: 请一周后回来复查。

vocab.example_en: Patients with chronic illnesses need regular follow-up checks.
vocab.example_zh: 慢性病患者需要定期复查。

vocab.example_en: A bacterial infection usually requires antibiotics.
vocab.example_zh: 细菌感染通常需要使用抗生素。

vocab.example_en: Rest and drink water if you catch a viral cold.
vocab.example_zh: 患病毒性感冒时要多休息、多喝水。

vocab.example_en: The nurse will check your pulse and blood pressure.
vocab.example_zh: 护士会检查你的脉搏和血压。

vocab.example_en: Adequate sleep helps boost your immunity.
vocab.example_zh: 充足睡眠有助于提升免疫力。

vocab.example_en: Please describe your symptoms in detail to the doctor.
vocab.example_zh: 请向医生详细描述你的症状。

vocab.example_en: Clean and dress the wound to prevent infection.
vocab.example_zh: 清洁伤口并包扎，防止感染。

vocab.example_en: Open wounds may develop infection if not treated properly.
vocab.example_zh: 伤口处理不当可能发生感染。

vocab.example_en: Most patients recover fully within two weeks.
vocab.example_zh: 大多数患者两周内可完全康复。

vocab.example_en: The doctor will prescribe medicine based on your symptoms.
vocab.example_zh: 医生会根据症状开药。

vocab.example_en: Don't jump to conclusions before all test results are in.
vocab.example_zh: 在所有检查结果出来前不要过早下定论。

vocab.example_en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet help boost immunity.
vocab.example_zh: 规律运动和均衡饮食有助于提升免疫力。

vocab.example_en: You can register an appointment online or at the front desk.
vocab.example_zh: 你可以在线上或前台挂号。

vocab.zh: 将病人转诊给专科医生
vocab.example_en: The GP may refer the patient to a specialist for further tests.
vocab.example_zh: 全科医生可将病人转诊给专科医生做进一步检查。

vocab.example_en: Please describe your discomfort to the doctor as clearly as possible.
vocab.example_zh: 请尽可能清晰地向医生描述你的不适。

vocab.zh: 你今天哪里不舒服？（诊所问诊专用）
vocab.example_en: What brings you in today? Let me know your main concern.
vocab.example_zh: 你今天哪里不舒服？请告诉我最主要的问题。

vocab.en: Wait for your number on the screen
vocab.example_en: Please wait for your number on the screen in the outpatient lobby.
vocab.example_zh: 请在门诊大厅屏幕等候叫号。

vocab.en: Drink plenty of water, get enough rest
vocab.example_en: Drink plenty of water, get enough rest, and you'll feel better soon.
vocab.example_zh: 多喝水、充分休息，你很快就会好转。
